name: LandRegistry

methods.name: is_government
methods.desc:
Check whether the current caller has
Government privileges.

methods.name: request_government_access
methods.desc:
Public wallet requests Government access.
One active request is maintained per wallet.

methods.name: get_government_request_count
methods.desc:
Government-only:
Return total number of access requests.

methods.name: get_my_government_request
methods.desc: Public caller checks their own request.

methods.name: register_land
methods.desc:
Government-only:
Register a new land parcel.

methods.name: transfer_ownership
methods.desc:
Government-only:
Transfer current ownership of a land.
Old owner remains permanently stored in ownership transfer history.

methods.name: get_transfer_count
methods.desc:
Return total number of ownership
transfers across all lands.

methods.name: get_land_transfer_count
methods.desc:
Return number of ownership transfers
for a specific land.

desc:
Decentralized Smart Land Registration
    & Boundary Verification System.

    Roles:
    - Government
    - Public

    Initial Government:
    - Contract creator

    Government permissions:
    - Register land
    - Verify land
    - Add boundary
    - Verify boundary
    - Transfer ownership
    - Approve / reject government requests

    Public permissions:
    - Read land records
    - Read boundary records
    - Request government access
    - Read request status
    - Read ownership history
